description.value: The Ramada by Wyndham Surrey/Langley is a mid-scale chain hotel situated on Highway 10 in Surrey, within the broader Langley/Surrey corridor of the Fraser Valley. As part of the Wyndham hotel family, guests can earn loyalty points on stays. Its highway-adjacent location makes it a practical overnight stop for cyclists passing through the Metro Vancouver suburbs on longer tours.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms an active Ramada by Wyndham Surrey/Langley property with a functioning booking interface, consistent with OSM tags. However, the fetched page is almost entirely the generic Wyndham booking portal UI with no property-specific amenity details, so no cyclist amenities (bike storage, laundry, wifi, etc.) can be confirmed from the website. OSM tags note internet_access=wlan with no fee, but per rules these cannot be treated as authoritative without website corroboration, so Wi-Fi is marked null. Phone and address are taken from OSM as the website content does not display them explicitly.
concerns: The fetched website is almost entirely generic Wyndham booking portal UI with no property-specific amenity content, making it impossible to confirm any amenities from the website. Cyclists seeking specific amenity details should contact the property directly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational chain hotel with an active booking website; a legitimate overnight option for touring cyclists passing through the Surrey/Langley area.
